review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Experimental Systems and Technology Lab (Ministry of Education)
review_candidates.description: GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity. At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round. Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today! Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg. [Background] Experimental Systems and Technology Lab (ESTL) of GovTech is an engineering team within the Ministry of Education (MOE). We are made up of engineers, user experience designers and education officers. Our team aims to design and develop software applications that help MOE to transform their systems and services through digitalisation and innovation. You can find out more about us at https://www.estl.edu.sg/. [What you will be working on] The Ministry of Education (MOE) is modernizing its flagship learning platform, the Student Learning Space (SLS). As a Software Engineer, you will be at the heart of this transformation. You will build the next-generation SLS — a scalable, high-impact platform designed to connect industry partners, teachers, and students within a vibrant education technology ecosystem. Your Responsibilities Include Feature Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-quality software modules for SLS. Technical Implementation: Write clean, testable, and efficient code while adhering to established engineering standards and best practices. Collaborative Design: Work closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Education Officers to translate pedagogical and curriculum requirements into seamless digital experiences. System Architecture: Contribute to architectural discussions and help make technical decisions that ensure the platform remains performant and maintainable. Code Quality: Participate in and conduct code reviews to ensure system coherence and mentor junior engineers in the team. DevOps & Reliability: Support the CI/CD pipeline and help manage cloud-native deployments to ensure high availability and security of services. Agile Participation: Engage in agile ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, estimations, and retrospectives to drive continuous improvement. [What we are looking for] Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience, preferably in a full-stack role Solid foundation in modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Node.js, Go) and frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Vue). Experience with cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure/GCP) and microservices. Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD tools. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot complex system issues and optimize performance. Excellent communication skills and a desire to work in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. A passion for learning new technologies and a commitment to fostering a culture of technical excellence and inclusion. What we offer you: GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation. Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers. Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

review_candidates.title: Data Scientist — Econometrics & MMM
review_candidates.description: The Role We are looking for a Data Scientist specializing in Econometrics and Causal Inference to join an early-stage technology company developing advanced data and decision-science capabilities. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of econometrics, statistics, causal inference and machine learning. You will be responsible for developing, testing and improving statistical and econometric methodologies that help organizations understand relationships between business activities and outcomes, measure impact, and make better data-driven decisions. You will work closely with the technical and product teams to turn sophisticated analytical methodologies into robust, scalable and repeatable solutions. What You’ll Do Develop and improve econometric and statistical models using real-world business data. Design methodologies for causal inference and impact measurement. Work with observational, experimental, time-series and panel data. Develop approaches for identifying and estimating causal effects in complex datasets. Address challenges such as confounding, selection bias, endogeneity, seasonality, autocorrelation, lagged effects and treatment heterogeneity. Develop and validate models for measuring the impact of different business activities on commercial outcomes. Research and evaluate new econometric and causal inference methodologies. Determine the appropriate methodology for different business questions, datasets and experimental settings. Build rigorous model validation and testing frameworks. Work with imperfect, incomplete and heterogeneous real-world datasets. Collaborate with engineers to translate analytical methodologies into production-ready models. Continuously evaluate model performance and improve methodologies based on empirical evidence. Clearly communicate analytical assumptions, limitations and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Required Experience Degree in Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or another highly quantitative field. Strong practical experience with econometric modeling and statistical analysis - a must Strong understanding of causal inference and causal identification - a must Experience working with time-series and/or panel data - a must Strong understanding of regression and statistical modeling techniques. Strong Python skills and experience with relevant data-science libraries. Experience working with real-world datasets rather than purely academic datasets. Ability to translate an ambiguous business question into a rigorous analytical methodology. Strong understanding of statistical assumptions and model limitations. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferred Experience Experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) - highly preferred. Experience with incrementality, lift measurement or experimentation - highly preferred. Practical experience with causal inference techniques such as: Difference-in-Differences Synthetic Control Instrumental Variables Regression Discontinuity Propensity Score / Matching Methods Causal Machine Learning Experience with Bayesian or probabilistic modeling. Experience with commercial, marketing, advertising, sales or customer data. Experience dealing with large-scale or high-dimensional datasets. Experience taking statistical models from research or prototype into production. Familiarity with modern causal inference frameworks and libraries. What We’re Looking For We are looking for someone who goes beyond simply applying statistical techniques. You should be comfortable asking: What are we actually trying to measure? What is the counterfactual? What assumptions are required to identify the effect? Can the available data actually answer the question? How robust is the result? How can we validate it against reality? You should be equally comfortable going deep into the methodology and explaining the implications of your analysis clearly to people without a technical background. The Right Mindset Scientifically rigorous — you care about methodological validity and evidence. Curious — you enjoy investigating why something happened rather than simply describing what happened. Pragmatic — you understand the difference between a theoretically perfect model and a useful real-world solution. Hands-on — you are comfortable writing code, exploring data, testing hypotheses and debugging models yourself. Product-minded — you want your methodologies to become repeatable capabilities rather than one-off analyses. Independent — you can take an ambiguous problem and develop a structured approach. Clear communicator — you can explain complex statistical concepts simply and effectively. Why Join? You will join at an early stage and have significant influence over the scientific and analytical foundations of the technology. This is an opportunity to work on challenging problems involving econometrics, causal inference, statistics, machine learning and large-scale business data, while helping turn advanced analytical methodologies into practical technology. The role offers significant ownership, close collaboration with the founding and technical teams, and the opportunity to shape both the methodology and its implementation from an early stage. Location Cyprus / Poland / Kyiv Remote in Europe Employment Full-time Reporting To CTO / Co-Founder Application Please submit your CV along with examples of relevant econometric, statistical, causal inference or data-science work where applicable.
